newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm says PCS service launched.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm says PCS service launched.

text.p: QUALCOMM Personal Electronics, a joint venture of QUALCOMM Inc and Sony Corp's Sony Electronics Inc, said Sprint Corp has launched its personal communications service (PCS) in several markets with CDMA-based phones made by the venture.
CDMA, or code division multiple access, is a technology used in digital transmission of data and voice signals that was developed by Qualcomm.
The new new PCS phones are distributed through Sprint PCS retail stores, as well as through major retail and electronics stores and direct sales channels.
Standard features of the phone include voice mail, incoming caller ID and short messaging. Cities in the Sprint launch include Fresno, Calif., Portland, Ore., Spokane, Wash. and Milwaukee, Wis.
